problem:
$5$ is less than $2$ **or** odd, **or** $9$ is composite.

Express the compound statement above in symbolic form given the following notations:

- $A:5\text{ is less than }2$

- $B:5\text{ is odd}$

- $C:9\text{ is composite}$

feedback.problem:
$7$ is prime **or** divisible by $10,$ **and** $5$ is rational **or** less than $100.$

Express the compound statement above in symbolic form given the following notations:

- $P:7\text{ is prime}$

- $D:7\text{ is divisible by }10$

- $Q:5\text{ is rational}$

- $L:5\text{ is less than }100$
feedback.worked_solution:
The word "and" is represented by the symbol "$∧$", while the word "or" is represented by the symbol "$∨$".

Note that this sentence consists of two parts:

- **Part 1:** $7$ is prime or divisible by $10.$ This corresponds to

$$
{{7\text{ is prime}}_{⏟}}_{P}\,{{\text{or}}_{⏟}}_{∨}\,{{7\text{ is divisible by }10}_{⏟}}_{D}
$$

that is, $P∨D.$

- **Part 2:** $5$ is rational or less than $100.$ This corresponds to

$$
{{5\text{ is rational}}_{⏟}}_{Q}\,{{\text{or}}_{⏟}}_{∨}\,{{5\text{ is less than }100}_{⏟}}_{L},
$$

that is, $Q∨L.$

So, we can express the sentence as

$$
{{7\text{ is prime }\text{or}\text{ divisible by }10}_{⏟}}_{P\,∨\,D}\,{{\text{and}}_{⏟}}_{∧}\,{{5\text{ is rational }\text{or}\text{ less than }100}_{⏟}}_{Q\,∨\,L},
$$

that is, $(P∨D)∧(Q∨L).$
